values.note: Water, dump station and ADA restrooms April-October (weather permitting); no showers.

facilities.source: https://www.mexicomissouri.net/586/Lakeview-Recreational-Campground ('Water and dump station are available at campground entrance April through October'; 'ADA restrooms available near campground April through October'; 'No shower houses'), read 2026-11-08

values.note: First come, first served on a permit bought from the camp host (on site April-October) or at the drop box before occupying a site; no advance reservations. Two-week limit in any 30 days; check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.mexicomissouri.net/586/Lakeview-Recreational-Campground ('Permits can be obtained from the Camp Host or drop box prior to occupying a site'; 'All campsites are first come, first serve'; 'No advance reservations accepted'; '2-week limit in a 30-day period'), read 2026-11-08

note: City of Mexico campground in Lakeview Park: a paved loop of sites south of the park lake, with a playground and trails nearby; manufactured homes not allowed. --Claude
summary: City page: single nights by permit at $20/day non-resident ($10 resident), bought from the camp host or the drop box on arrival, FCFS only, 14 nights in 30; 30/50A at every site, water and dump at the entrance Apr-Oct, no showers. Waterfront lead: lakeview unproven - pads ~130-150 m from the lake across the loop road, park road and scattered trees.
flags: PERMIT: a traveller can buy a single night - the permit is per day per site, $20 for non-residents, taken from the camp host (April-October) or the drop box before occupying a site; no reservations. So it stays as an FCFS public campground.

WATERFRONT re-audit lead (stored lakeview -> not waterfront): on Esri imagery the RV pads sit inside the south half of the campground loop (~39.1525,-91.8950), ~130-150 m from the south shore of the park lake, with the loop's north arc, the main park road, a restroom building and scattered trees in between; the pads face into the loop. No photo or source shows the lake from a site, so under the unsure-means-down rule it goes to not waterfront.
Pin: 39.1530,-91.8970 sits by the substation west of the campground, ~175 m from the pads (under the 250 m line; optional move to 39.1525,-91.8950, the loop).
